dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Sertraline-induced myoclonus with associated cognitive impairment, representing incipient serotonin syndrome from combined SSRI (sertraline) and serotonergic antipsychotic (risperidone) therapy

Alternatives:
1. Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (rapidly progressive dementia with myoclonus, though MRI/EEG/CSF lack supportive findings)
2. Established serotonin syndrome (autonomic instability and hyperreflexia not yet elicited)
3. Autoimmune encephalitis (e.g., anti-LGI1 or anti-NMDA receptor – antibody panel not yet performed)
